verdicts.reason: A: the three flavour pills are out of their original order (Honey Rosemary first, Blood Orange alone on a second row) and scattered across two rows, Cucumber Mint sits on the peach circle, and the subhead wraps into a cramped 3-line column, but the headline still clearly leads and the CTA is sized sensibly. B: the Shop Flavours button is blown up until it competes with the headline, which squeezes the subhead into a 4-line sliver of tiny text with awkward breaks.
